newsitem.title: UK: Euro veg oils lower, market sensitive to futures.
newsitem.headline: Euro veg oils lower, market sensitive to futures.

text.p: Midday European vegetable oil prices were mostly lower on Tuesday in featureless trading.
Traders said the market was sensitive to movement in futures markets in Asia and north America.
"There is nothing new to give the market direction so people are watching the futures market more than usual," said one trader.
Lower futures markets in Asia and Chicago made buyers back off a little during the morning, but the tone of the market remains firm.
"The market is very steady and the fact buyers have backed off a little does not mean they are not interested," said another trader.
Holidays coming up in the Netherlands on Wednesday and most of Europe and Malaysia on Thursday also affected business.
At midday crude palm oil cif Europe was $2.50 down after Apr traded at $572.50 in a switch with Jun at $570 a tonne cif.
Among products RBD palm oil was $5 to $7.50 down while olein was $5 lower after May 7 traded at $602.50, Jun from $597.50 down to $591, Jul at $580 and Jul/Sep at $577.50 a tonne fob Malaysian ports.
Lauric oil sellers were $2.50 down to unchanged while soft oils were 0.50 guilders lower to unchanged.
